definition: tied up so you cannot move
description: On the sunny wooden deck of a sailing yacht, a young man in a navy linen shirt and white trousers sits on a folding wooden chair, tied to it with many loops of pink ribbon around his chest and arms, and laughs. A young woman in a yellow sundress ties a big pink bow on top of his head, while a young woman in a red swimsuit and white shirt pulls more ribbon tight around him. Rolls of pink ribbon lie on the deck, with the mast, steel rails and blue sea behind.

taps.phrase: to sit bound to a chair
to tie a big pink bow
